dedupe_keys.name: uberwachte lawinenstriche im zustandigkeitsbereich einer lawinenkommission

description: Überwachte Lawinenstriche im Zuständigkeitsbereich einer Lawinenkommission is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by lfu.bayern.de. Supervised avalanche strikes in the area of responsibility of an avalanche commission. The registered avalanche marks reflect the level of knowledge about avalanches in their largest known extent, insofar as these avalanches pose a danger to buildings, mountain railways and ski lifts as well as traffic routes, ski slopes and toboggan runs. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Supervised avalanche strikes in the area of responsibility of an avalanche commission" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include opendata, Lawinenkataster, Lawine, UmweltAtlas, Lawinenkommission, inspireidentifiziert. The listing shows 3 download or service links in WFS, WMS. The listing shows 2025-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
